notes: 1.10.2 - More Armor Trims now runs on its native NeoForge build instead of the Fabric one, so it no longer needs Sinytra Connector. Same mod, same version 1.5.3, your existing trims are unaffected. Also from 1.10.1: Parachute, Grand Teleport and Camera Overhaul have been removed from the pack, and Just Zoom is now version 2.0.0. Everything from 1.10.0 is still here: VR support (Vivecraft, MC VR API and the Sable compatibility fixes), Customizable Player Models, the new Season 2 title screen, and the new Normal/Potato Mode button in Aero Settings that switches off the heaviest client mods for low-end PCs and puts them back on demand. Sable 2.0.5 and Create: Aeronautics 1.3.2 with Drive-By-Wire, ragdolls, SSRD and Distant Horizons 3.2.0. Create gets LazyTick and Threaded Trains. Sodium 0.8.13, and Dynamic FPS, Continuity, ImmediatelyFast and Longer Chat History all moved onto proper NeoForge builds. The update screens have been rebuilt to match the rest of the pack. THIS IS THE LAST UPDATE THAT RESETS YOUR SETTINGS - from now on the updater leaves your keybinds, video/audio options, chosen shader and Xaero map settings alone. Carry On needs LEFT CTRL + right-click to pick a block up.
